answer: Registration locks a locked liquidity-pool share as a slashable bond: an identity costs real money. signature comparison across the public ledger exposes any agent caught signing two conflicting attestations in one epoch. The penalty follows at once: slashing is tiered: ten percent, then fifty, then the whole bond. An onyx with no bond earns no attestation rights. The registry maps each trellis to exactly one bond, never two. The fable bond is the price of admission, and farms pay it per fake.
